interpretation: Frozen20-class held-out test, subject to audit limitations
notes: All scores are cosine similarities, not calibrated probabilities.
Overall macro metrics average all20 classes. Each source macro averages its ground-truth-supported classes (EuroSAT forest/river); source-balanced metrics average source metrics equally.

mCA12 is the unweighted mean over all12 documented conditions on the full pool, including explicitly unchanged/inapplicable resolution rows. EuroSAT source mCA excludes128 and64 (10 conditions); NWPU mCA uses12. No hidden denominator changes.
No tuning using these test results. Test split is reused exactly; old-model EuroSAT exposure is documented in benchmark_manifest.json.

Average inference timing is null where old features were reused. --measure-latency measures shared encoding plus scoring; it is not isolated request latency. Actual encoding batch sizes are recorded per chunk; changing batch size on resume produces mixed-batch timing averages.
